title: Prezzy Cards
tagline: The Prezzy Cards is a cards issuance protocol that enables users to mint NFTs as any kind of cards
description: The Prezzy Cards is a cards issuance protocol that enables users to mint NFTs as any kind of card. You can mint one and send it to your loved ones, for example, you can mint gift cards, greeting cards, holiday cards, birthday cards, and you name a few, most importantly, the cards are not only on-chain recorded images or videos but you can also store a certain amount of fungible tokens into it and the receivers can redeem or claim it themselves, or even they can use it to pay their purchases of something in a privileged price.
